item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President recounts an earlier request that the Commission investigate and report; this is executive fact-finding and reporting, not a change in legal rights.","evidence":"I requested the United States International Trade Commission to make an immediate investigation"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President requests continued investigation and a report, while the Secretary’s completed determination is recited as background; no legal consequence is imposed by this segment.","evidence":"requesting that the United States International Trade Commission continue its investigation"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory emergency-necessity finding permitting import fees to be imposed without awaiting the Commission’s recommendations.","evidence":"I find and declare that the imposition of the import fees hereinafter proclaimed, without awaiting the recommendations"},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"The President directly amends the tariff schedule, establishes binding fee formulas, and fixes the market stabilization price for specified periods; later calculations implement this present legal act.","evidence":"Headnote 4 of part 3 of the Appendix to the TSUS is continued in effect and amended"},{"segment_id":"5","code":2,"rationale":"The segment mandates the Secretary to calculate and announce legally applicable quarterly fees under the prescribed formula and to certify and publish them later.","evidence":"The Secretary shall determine the amount of the quarterly fees"},{"segment_id":"6","code":3,"rationale":"The proclamation itself amends tariff items to impose specified fees and establishes their applicability, adjustment, exemption, and termination rules; agency calculations are implementation of those present legal rules.","evidence":"Items 956.05, 956.15 and 957.15 of part 3 of the Appendix to the TSUS are continued in effect and amended"},{"segment_id":"7","code":3,"rationale":"The President directly terminates the earlier proclamation, sets this proclamation’s effective time, and creates a binding exception for specified articles.","evidence":"The provisions of Proclamation 4887 of December 23, 1981 are hereby terminated"}]}
